# Anton Zhilin — Frontend Developer

> Portfolio of Anton Zhilin, a Moscow-based frontend developer specializing in React, Next.js, and TypeScript. Builds responsive, pixel-perfect interfaces with a focus on performance and WCAG 2.1 accessibility.

- [Projects](https://antoshkindev.ru/projects): Full case-study portfolio — e-commerce platforms, landing pages, and SPAs built with React, Next.js, and vanilla JS.
